rules.coordinates: OperationalPlan/action JSON tile is [row,col]. Runtime tile is (x=col,y=row), converted as (col,row).
rules.damage: Current formula layer: physical max(0.05A,A-D); arts max(0.05A,0.01A*(100-RES)); attack interval T0/(clamp(S,10,600)/100).
rules.economy: Natural DP and provided ledger deltas are model calculations. Refunds, skill DP and merchant upkeep are only valid with their stated evidence and conditions.
rules.range_orientation: GameData range offsets are stored for RIGHT. ApproximateRealRangeTransformer rotates them in bottom-left field coordinates.
rules.simulator_win: Current Simulator wins when no enemy leaks, the spawn schedule is exhausted, and no active enemies remain.
rules.time_sp_recovery: Current public low-rarity runtime advances time-SP by 1.0 SP/s only while inactive. SP is paused while a skill is active.
rules.unknown: Exact client timing, active roadblock ordinary-WALK navigation, target priority and unsupported effects remain UNKNOWN unless supplied evidence says otherwise.

corridor_responsibilities.responsibility: Steward sustains eastern vertical damage; Durin supplements the upper eastern stop. Both medics must remain alive and deliver treatment through confirmed artillery destruction before frame 4800.
Melantha clears eastern restraint #3 while intercepting upper hostiles. The civilian travels to western restraint #1; Castle releases it after artillery destruction. Record its actual safe arrival.
Fang hands upper central retention to Spot. Cross-lane attacks, Midnight arts and later Lava clear accumulated enemies under both medics.
Vanilla hands lower central retention to Midnight. Durin supplies temporary assistance; Lava assumes sustained arts support after artillery destruction.
Melantha clears opening pressure, Beagle retains the paired officers, and Noir Corne retains the final three. Western upper civilian exposure is protected by maintained eastern interception.
Plume clears opening pressure and eastern restraint #4. Cardigan retains all later officers with Ansel's extended-range windows available as supplemental healing.

Eastern restraint #4 must be destroyed before civilian contact. Maintain lower interception while it reaches western restraint #2; release it with redeployed Durin after artillery destruction and verified separation from surviving officers.

Lower outer interception and eastern lower restraint damage.

Heal both central positions, both artillery casters and Hibiscus.
Heal both central positions, both artillery casters and Ansel.
Replace Plume with three-block lower outer retention; ordinary attacks only.
Replace Melantha; absorb paired upper officers and artillery exposure.
Supplement artillery damage during its upper eastern stop; assist lower central clearance.
Lower central interception, cross-lane assistance and scheduled arts damage.
Three-block upper central retention; ordinary attacks only.
Post-artillery single-target arts support covering both central positions.
Fresh upper outer defender for the final three officers.
Final western lower restraint clearance after redeployment cooldown.

formation_structure.artillery: Steward covers the eastern vertical from [2,7] UP. Durin at [5,5] RIGHT adds a separate damage position during the stop at [5,7]. Neither highest-defense targeting nor prescribed target ordering is assumed.
formation_structure.medical: Ansel at [2,6] UP and Hibiscus at [5,6] DOWN share the rectangle spanning rows 2-5 and columns 5-7. Each can heal the other, Steward, the first Durin position and both central blockers. Their assigned baseline coverage does not include the outer blockers.
formation_structure.opening: Fang and Vanilla face across adjacent central lanes. Lancet faces downward from [5,5], covering both. Melantha and Plume supply substantially stronger independent opening duels than the former temporary defenders.
formation_structure.outer: Melantha hands upper interception to Beagle; Plume hands lower interception to Cardigan. After paired upper officers are cleared, Noir Corne replaces Beagle for the final upper officers. These defenders do not depend on unsupported healing skills.
formation_structure.terminal: Spot, Midnight, Lava and both medics retain central defense. Castle clears the western upper restraint, then its slot passes to redeployed Durin for the western lower restraint.

formation_transitions.transition: Plume yields [6,5] to Cardigan. Eastern lower restraint destruction must already be recorded; Cardigan does not inherit adjacent-device clearance.
Melantha yields [1,5] to Beagle. Eastern upper restraint destruction and the opening upper hostile kills must already be recorded.
Lancet yields [5,5] to Durin only after both regular medics are deployed and healing.
Vanilla yields lower central interception to Midnight; no later Vanilla DP is credited.
Fang yields upper central interception to Spot; no later Fang DP is credited.
After recorded artillery death, Steward yields its slot to Castle and Durin yields [5,5] to downward-facing Lava. Surviving artillery invalidates both handoffs.
Beagle yields upper outer interception to fresh Noir Corne after both paired upper officers have been killed.
After recorded western upper restraint destruction, Castle yields its slot to Durin at [5,2]. Durin has completed at least 70 seconds off field.

pressure_window_responsibilities.responsibility: Preserve the mutually covering vanguards, keep opening healing active, and establish both stronger outer interceptors before runner passage. Ansel must deploy and begin actual treatment.
Complete mutual medic coverage, finish both eastern restraints, replace wounded outer interceptors, and establish sustained artillery damage.

Both medics sustain artillery casters and central blockers simultaneously. Replace central vanguards without losing conditional economy. Confirm artillery destruction before withdrawing either artillery caster.
Lava and Midnight clear central armor; fresh Noir Corne assumes final upper pressure. Castle clears the western upper restraint while every hostile corridor remains staffed.
Durin clears the western lower restraint. Retain both central blockers, both medics, Lava and outer defenders until all hostiles are dead and both protected targets have safely arrived.
